name: leer
description: Reads Claude's last response aloud: natural edge-tts voices (free, no API key) with an offline fallback to the OS voice, plus pause and stop buttons.

engine.title: Speech engine
engine.description: auto = edge-tts, falling back to the OS voice when offline or not installed. edge-tts = always edge-tts. system = always the OS voice (say on macOS, SAPI on Windows, espeak-ng on Linux).

voice.title: edge-tts voice
voice.description: Any voice from `edge-tts --list-voices`, e.g. es-CO-GonzaloNeural, es-VE-PaolaNeural, es-US-AlonsoNeural, en-US-AndrewNeural.

systemVoice.title: System voice
systemVoice.description: OS voice for the fallback. Empty = the system default. macOS: `say -v '?'`; Windows: an installed SAPI voice name; Linux: `espeak-ng --voices`.

edgeTts.title: edge-tts command
edgeTts.description: Name or full path of the edge-tts executable.
